title: Halting relation
statement: Let $g$ and $d$ be configurations as in the track relation, and fix a program node and a call specification with its register-word assignment. They satisfy the halting relation if there exist a segment index $s$, Boolean parity and direction values, and a track position $t$ such that $g$ is in the return state carrying the first bit of $d$'s output, or false if that output is empty; $d$ has halted; and the configurations satisfy the track relation at those parameters.

A configuration g with m+k_D work tapes on x
